description: issue-to-pr safety gate. One PreToolUse hook on Bash: merge-guard.sh denies `gh pr merge --admin` so branch protection is never bypassed, and asks on a bare force-push (`--force-with-lease` passes, since it refuses when the remote moved). Every other command passes through to the normal permission flow. Plugin agents ignore hooks, so this protects the main session only -- merges must run there.
